data.name: Coastline Courier
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME

Congratulations! You're now the head of the Anssoloin post office!

After years of hard work at the capital, you've finally been able to acquire a postal franchise by the sea. So, you recently arrived in this small coastal village. A picturesque place with charming locals. As you'll see, the post office plays a central role in commerce and social relations. Will you be able to integrate into your new life?
Learn more about the village and its residents through your job.
Sort the mail, chat, relax.

CONTENTS

  • Discover Anssoloin and its residents

    Chat with the locals who come to the counter. Learn more about them and the life of the village through the mail that passes through your hands.

    More than 30 notable characters to discover.

  • Help the village prosper

    Help the village by making the right choices and performing your messenger duties to the best of your ability. Late mail could mean a canceled wedding, a layoff, or even a job loss. Too many mistakes and you risk losing your post office.

    Many stories whose endings depend on you and your actions.

  • Collect stamps!

    Yes, what better place than yours to stay up-to-date on the latest releases!

    Lots of stamps to collect.

  • Relax

    You're in a relaxing setting, time stands still in your little post office.

    Take all the time you want to sort the mail, pet the cat, listen to the radio, admire the scenery from the window, etc.

    A cozy atmosphere.

Learn more about the village and its residents through your work. Will you be able to fit in your new community? Sort the mail, discover new things, chat, and relax.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo E8200, AMD FX-4100, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 510 (Skylake), AMD Radeon R5 Graphics (Kaveri)
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K, AMD Ryzen 5 1600, Snapdragon X Elite
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 (Pascal), AMD Radeon RX 460 (GCN 4.0)
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
